teaching_point: Heliotrope rash — violaceous upper-eyelid erythema ± oedema; pathognomonic pattern of dermatomyositis.

teaching_point: Gottron papules — violaceous flat-topped papules over MCP/IP joints (pathognomonic). Contrast SLE, which favours the skin between the knuckles.
dermnet_caption: Gottron papules over the joints of the hands
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Gottron papules over the joints of the hands (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/adult-onset-dermatomyositis

teaching_point: Shawl sign — photodistributed poikilodermatous erythema over shoulders/upper back; itchy (unlike most SLE rashes).
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Shawl sign over the shoulder (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/adult-onset-dermatomyositis

teaching_point: V-sign — photosensitive erythema of the anterior neck/upper chest.
dermnet_caption: Photosensitive rash on the V of chest
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Photosensitive rash on the V of chest (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/adult-onset-dermatomyositis

teaching_point: Ragged cuticles and nailfold erythema/dilated capillaries — a quick bedside clue to connective tissue disease.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Ragged cuticles and nailfold redness (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/adult-onset-dermatomyositis

teaching_point: Gottron sign — macular violaceous erythema over the knees/elbows; ask about proximal weakness (rising from a chair) and dysphagia.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Gottron sign over the knees (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/adult-onset-dermatomyositis

teaching_point: Cutaneous metastasis (carcinoma erysipeloides from adenocarcinoma) — skin metastases from lung cancer typically appear on the chest wall, scalp and abdomen as firm nodules; biopsy any new firm nodule in a smoker.
dermnet_caption: Metastatic adenocarcinoma of unknown origin (carcinoma erysipeloides)
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Metastatic adenocarcinoma of unknown origin (carcinoma erysipeloides) (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/skin-metastasis

teaching_point: Tripe palms — velvety, ridged palmar thickening; strongly paraneoplastic (lung cancer when alone; gastric when with AN).
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Tripe palms (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/tripe-palms

teaching_point: Wide purple (livid) striae — the Cushing's clue; exogenous (incl. potent topical/inhaled) steroids are the commonest cause.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Streoid striae (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/cushing-syndrome

teaching_point: Thin skin with purpura — glucocorticoid excess (endogenous or iatrogenic); with proximal myopathy and hypertension, test for Cushing's.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Atrophy and purpura (© Raimo Suhonen) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/cushing-syndrome

teaching_point: Moon face/plethora from systemic steroids — iatrogenic Cushing's.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Moon face (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/systemic-steroids

teaching_point: Axillary hyperhidrosis — visible sweat patches; new onset at 40 with forehead + axillae + all-day sweating = look for a secondary cause.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Excessive sweating in armpits (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/hyperhidrosis

teaching_point: Palmar hyperhidrosis — typical primary focal pattern (onset <25 y, stops during sleep); tap-water iontophoresis is effective for palms/soles.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Palmar hyperhidrosis (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/drug-induced-hyperhidrosis

teaching_point: Eruptive xanthomas — crops of yellow papules with a red halo. Request lipids today (TG often >10–20 mmol/L).
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Eruptive xanthomas (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/xanthoma

teaching_point: Eruptive xanthomas close-up — red-yellow dome papules on extensor/buttock skin; pancreatitis risk with severe hypertriglyceridaemia.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Eruptive xanthomas (© Raimo Suhonen) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/xanthoma

teaching_point: Larger coalescing (tubero-eruptive) xanthomas — persistent severe hypertriglyceridaemia; lesions regress over weeks–months once TG and glycaemia are controlled.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Eruptive xanthomas (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/xanthoma

teaching_point: Acanthosis nigricans over the knuckles/dorsal hand in skin of colour — velvety hyperpigmented thickening; acral AN is common in darker skin.
licence_note: DermNet image licence: https://dermnetnz.org/image-licence (watermarked low-res; personal/educational use with attribution)
attribution: Image: DermNet — Acanthosis nigricans (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/tripe-palms

teaching_point: Erythema nodosum with fever in sarcoidosis — Löfgren syndrome (EN + bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy ± ankle arthritis).

attribution: Image: DermNet — Fever and a rash (© DermNet) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/sarcoidosis

teaching_point: Bilateral hilar lymphadenopathy on CXR — DDx TB and lymphoma (weight loss + night sweats in the case).

attribution: Image: DermNet — Bihilar lymphadenopathy in sarcoidosis (DermNet (open access)) — https://dermnetnz.org/topics/sarcoidosis

teaching_point: Lupus pernio — violaceous nasal/cheek plaques; chronic sarcoid with upper respiratory tract and lung involvement.

teaching_point: Scar sarcoid on a pierced earlobe mimicking keloid — sarcoid infiltrates old scars/tattoos.

teaching_point: Plaque sarcoid on cheek and nose — red-brown "apple-jelly" plaques on diascopy; biopsy shows non-caseating granulomas.

teaching_point: Excoriated papules along the posterior hairline/scalp — a less-recognised DH site (with elbows, knees, buttocks).

teaching_point: Pyoderma gangrenosum on the shin — undermined violaceous edge; pretibial is the commonest site.

teaching_point: Pathergic PG after surgery — trauma, debridement and surgery worsen PG: do not debride.
